company_name: Dandong Xin Dongfang Crystal Instrument Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in manufacturing X-ray orientation units and other measurement equipment critical for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Dandong Xin Dongfang Crystal Instrument Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of X-ray orientation units, focusing on research, development, production, and sales within the semiconductor equipment sector. The company is recognized for its innovative technology and quality assurance, producing over three new products annually to meet industry demands.

regional_presence.China: The company is the largest R&D and production base for mono-crystal orientation units in China.
